REPORT zcv_macro.

DEFINE delete_flights.
  DELETE FROM zsflight WHERE carrid = &1.
  IF sy-dbcnt > 0.
    WRITE sy-dbcnt.
  ENDIF.
END-OF-DEFINITION.

START-OF-SELECTION.
* Each call expands to sy-dbcnt, a component access; the definition itself is
* no code of the generated class.
  delete_flights 'AA'.
  delete_flights 'LH'.
